title: The Stark Tower From The Avengers Film (An Exact Replica!)
author: Minecraft Expert

generated.description: A tall, exact replica of the Stark Tower from the Avengers films, built as a slender modern skyscraper with a grid of light gray and gray wool, spruce planks, and many glass panes for windows. It stands about 150 blocks high, 43 wide and 81 deep, with a wide base that narrows into a lit spire-like top. The build uses a large amount of material (over 61,000 blocks) and includes a few furnaces, signs, and traps inside.
